angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 2,226,240 km at 570.16 pc = 0.05 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 1.7539 +/- 0.0119 mas (same row, RUWE 0.81): 570.16 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 3.2 +/- 0.01 solar radii from Guenther et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-2049 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026AJ....172...54G/abstract): 2,226,240 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.57 +/- 0.03 solar masses from Guenther et al. 2026, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-2049 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026AJ....172...54G/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6164 +/- 202 K from Guenther et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-2049 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026AJ....172...54G/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Guenther et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-2049 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026AJ....172...54G/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-2049.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 3.624, rounded to two decimals
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, TOI-2049: main object type *, Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2049 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.311 dex, from Guenther et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026AJ....172...54G/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2049 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 1.1038, from Guenther et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026AJ....172...54G/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2049 (pscomppars): age 2.2 Gyr, from Guenther et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026AJ....172...54G/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2049 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 16 km/s, from Guenther et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026AJ....172...54G/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
